text: `REMOTE_AGENTS_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE=1 uv run --locked pytest tests/live/test_codex_shared_daemon_attribution.py -q -p no:randomly` (gated on `REMOTE_AGENTS_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE=1`, like `test_codex_activity_hooks.py`; skips only with a `BLOCKED:` reason)
why: Live drill against a real Codex daemon: each run spends a Codex turn on the owner's account, and the owner approved one. The drill ran once and passed (1 passed, 25 s). A break run would spend a second, unapproved turn. The line it exercises -- the spool's roster branch in activity_spool.py -- is proven host-side by proof/2026-10-13-codex-hook-attribution-plan/1.2/claim-1.json, whose break removes that read_roster call and goes RED.
